family_readiness.scope_note: GHMP-superfamily kinases phosphorylate small-molecule hydroxyl/carboxyl acceptors using ATP in a GHMP fold; this packet separates them from PfkB/PfkA/ASKHA/dNK/NDK/GHKL/ATP-grasp/ePK boundary lanes.

available_review_only_evidence: Family expansion maps one expert-supported GHMP boundary row: 4-(cytidine 5-prime-diphospho)-2-C-methyl-D-erythritol kinase.
The selected structure has local CDM substrate/product-like context and structure-level ANP context, but the nucleotide is not local to the active-site slice used here.
Current geometry retrieval routes the row through metal-dependent hydrolase top1 at 0.3581, below the 0.4115 floor.
blocked_or_missing_evidence: No accepted source-free GHMP fold axis exists in production code.
No calibrated small-molecule acceptor identity policy exists for GHMP.
No GHMP threshold, external hard-negative re-audit, or countable positive seed set exists.
The row remains current-review boundary evidence and cannot be imported or used to expand the fingerprint universe without a separate gated cycle.
